search_text: published ZDI-23-1623 ZDI-CAN-21529 TP-Link TL-WR902AC loginFs Improper Authentication Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2023-11-14 CVE-2023-44447 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-44447 6.5 AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N ['TP-Link'] ['TL-WR902AC'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of TP-Link TL-WR902AC routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. The issue results from improper authentication. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise. Fixed in TL-WR902AC(EU)_V1_231027 and TL-WR902AC(US)_V1_231025 https://www.tp-link.com/en/support/download/tl-wr902ac/v1/#Firmware https://www.tp-link.com/us/support/download/tl-wr902ac/v1/#Firmware ['2023-08-03 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2023-11-14 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Aleksandar Djurdjevic 'revengsmK' https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-23-1623/
title: TP-Link TL-WR902AC loginFs Improper Authentication Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of TP-Link TL-WR902AC routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. The issue results from improper authentication. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise.
